obsidian.$description: Obsidian — Page canvas, primary background — the ground everything sits on

carbon.$description: Carbon — Elevated card surfaces, nav text, deep backgrounds one step above the canvas

graphite.$description: Graphite — Card and button borders — the hairline skeleton that defines structure

slate-mist.$description: Slate Mist — Subtle background fills, muted surface overlays

fog.$description: Fog — Muted body text, secondary copy, icon fills — readable but recedes

ash.$description: Ash — Icon strokes, tertiary text, soft fills

bone.$description: Bone — Light body text variant on dark surfaces

chalk.$description: Chalk — Primary hairline border color — dividers, card edges, input borders; the most-used border in the system

paper-white.$description: Paper White — Light neutral action fill for buttons on dark surfaces.

signal-green.$description: Signal Green — Supporting palette color for small decorative accents when the core palette needs contrast.

neue.$description: Sole typeface across all surfaces. Weight 300 for display and hero headlines — deliberately light, anti-convention for a technical product, creating authority through restraint. Weight 400 for body copy. Weight 500 for nav, labels, and emphasized UI text. Weight 700 reserved for high-emphasis callouts. Tight negative tracking scales with size: -0.028em at 60px tightens large headlines into a single visual mass; tracking relaxes to near-zero at body sizes. The full range from 11px captions to 60px display gives the system a wide, confident scale without ever feeling like two different typefaces.
